import json
from dys import get_script_address, get_script_name


def wsgi(environ, start_response):

    script_address = get_script_address()
    script_name = get_script_name()

    p = environ.get("PATH_INFO", "")
    if p == "/host.json":
        # Call /redirect-to-dwapp/{dys name or address}/host.json, follow the redirect to get the HTTP_HOST
        start_response(
            "200 OK",
            [
                ("Content-type", "application/json; charset=utf-8"),
                ("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*"),
                ("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS"),
                ("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "*"),
            ],
        )
        return [
            json.dumps(
                {"HTTP_HOST": environ["HTTP_HOST"]}, ensure_ascii=False, default=str
            ).encode("utf-8")
        ]

    html = f"""
# script_address
{script_address}

# get_script_name
{script_name}

# Environ
{json.dumps(environ, indent=1, default=str)}
    """

    start_response("200 OK", [("Content-type", "text/plane; charset=UTF-8")])
    return [html.encode()]
